red_green_evidence: First protocol test failed before the query-focus module existed, then passed.

verified_behavior: Query-only payload; strict enum/field schema and exact uniquely located query excerpts. Server computes UTF-16 start/end.
Feature-off/self/unknown/failure complete evidence content, scores and ordering match baseline in generic fixtures.
Only actual third-party fact prior is relaxed; source/raw and operation-event factors, lifecycle visibility, candidate 200 / evidence 32 / token 6000 settings remain unchanged.
Classification and embedding execute concurrently; worker search/candidates/pack consistently receive the same focus.

Standard Models with loopback provider tests enforce single transport even with ordinary configured attempts=3, 512 tokens, 4096 characters, invalid-output fallback, actual deadline socket cancellation, parent abort propagation and cache behavior.
Cache: exact query plus prompt/model configuration fingerprint, 128 LRU entries, five minutes, valid decisions only; failure/timeout/aborted work not cached.
remaining_uncertainty: No live semantic query classification or new QA was performed. Authored unit packets test protocol handling, not actual model accuracy.

other_people relaxes the prior for actual third-party facts, including named-entity mismatches. It does not certify all people are relevant; the independent holdout and recorded-query paired study remain necessary.
The classifier may return unknown on short-deadline/format/provider failure and preserve baseline retrieval. Parent cancellation still aborts Search.
